resources.string: Fetching the kernel cache from Apple\'s servers
Loading the kernel into the emulated iPhone

Nothing of iOS is inside this app. The kernel cache (7.4 MB) is downloaded from Apple\'s own servers, the same file sysimage/ios6/fetch.sh fetches on a desktop. The system volume of this release\'s image stays on Apple\'s servers until the emulator grows the drivers to use it.

Apple stores the kernel cache of iOS 6 AES-256 encrypted. To boot it, the app needs the key and IV of this exact file from your own research -- none are shipped, none are derived. Without a key you can still boot the bundled self-test kernel, which exercises the same loader, CPU and display without any Apple code.
